claims.claim: The S.W.A.T. line includes original, Sports, Trail and Street editions with different constructions.
The original White uses a Phylon/TPR sole, canvas upper and Advanced Memory Foam insock.
The Olive/Black Sports Edition uses a Phylon/TPR sole, mesh/synthetic upper and Advanced Memory Foam insock and is positioned for basketball and training.
The Sage Green/Black Trail Edition uses a Phylon/TPR sole, mesh/synthetic upper and EVA insock.
The Cream/Mocha Street Edition uses a synthetic sole, mesh/synthetic upper and Advanced Memory Foam insock.

claims.criteria: Every use of the word top appears in the compound footwear term high-top. It never makes a superiority, ranking or best-product claim.
claims.statement: High-top is used as a product silhouette description and keyword, not as a claim that the collection ranks above alternatives.
